item.title: Elevated river flows and risk of ice jams possible due to mild weather
item.description: Mild temperatures and rainfall this week have resulted in increased river flows and water levels that will remain elevated throughout the Grand River watershed into next week. The Grand River Conservation Authority stated in a press release Friday morning that low-lying areas that are prone to flooding may be at risk due to river flows that are higher than normal […]

item.title: One in four local households experience food insecurity: GEPH report
item.description: One in four households in Brantford-Brant and Haldimand-Norfolk are experiencing food insecurity. That’s the crux of a report presented by registered dieticians to Grand Erie Public Health board members on Wednesday. The figure is derived from recent statistics that also show one in three children in Ontario live in a food-insecure household, increasing the risk of hyperactivity and inattention.
